display_name: LoRa W24 第二次 MAP 自适应投影上限
description: 固定原 W24 两级预测和四次 CG，仅提高第二次 MAP 后允许写回的包内中心修正。
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms scratch, identical two-prior network and initial state.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weights inherited during fitting. Runtime source metadata and frozen state require original contract. No target or TX ancestry in fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at step 3600. On the preassigned 300-packet Full source panel, adaptive-radius half must exceed direct, matched control half and archival 40k fixed half on the six-scene count, meet all three on low urban and meet direct on clean. Only then run three formal Full shards of 10000 packets each.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU pool 0, 5, 6, 7 in enumerated order on N607. One worker per card, two total, at least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight compute processes per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer and local experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --final-radius once formal shards freeze.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 3600 optimizer updates at batch 16; identical schedule.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 3600 optimizer updates at batch 16; identical schedule.

notes: Both arms use identical seed, scratch two-prior structure, four CG, 20,000 U_s fit and 500 held U_s, generic paired perturbations, AdamW batch 16, fixed step 3,600. W24, TX, V, target and traces are excluded in fit.

Only the second MAP output projection differs. The packet-weighted native off-band noise q determines the final radius R=min(0.95,sqrt(0.55^2+4q)). Original coarse, prior, action, variance, first MAP projection and fixed half readout are maintained. The same feasible endpoint is used during fit and prediction.
The source Full contrast reports both actual half and frozen full readouts. Formal is Full only, with E104 after candidate freeze and local independent truth-last scoring after all shards are fixed.
